name: Corrosive Staff (Greater)
text:
A sickly green liquid sloshes inside this hollow glass staff, carrying an acrid scent. While wielding the staff, you gain resistance 6 to acid damage.

---
Activate Cast a Spell

Effect You expend a number of charges from the staff to cast a spell from its list.
- Cantrip Caustic Blast

- 1st Acidic Burst

- 2nd Acid Grip, Disintegrating Puddle

- 3rd Acidic Burst, Noxious Metals

---
Craft Requirements Supply one casting of all listed ranks of all listed spells.
